outcome: Prevalence of exclusive breastfeeding (EBF) at 3 months postpartum
Factors associated with breastfeeding initiation and continuation
finding: Early SSC was significantly associated with the type of feeding at discharge, 1 month, 2 months, and 3 months postpartum.
mod_finding: Early SSC was performed in 92% of vaginal births but only 57% of urgent cesarean births.
